description: Grok Build hooks for session context, browser-intent, destructive/publish protection, file path policy, roster advice, and HammerTime

hooks.command: BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT="${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-context.sh"; if [ ! -f "$BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT" ]; then BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-context.sh"; fi; if [ ! -f "$BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT" ]; then BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT=$(ls -t "$HOME/.grok/installed-plugins/"*/hooks/session-context.sh 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); fi; if [ -f "$BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT" ]; then BOPEN_HOOK_RUNTIME=grok bash "$BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT"; fi

BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT="${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/browser-intent.sh"; if [ ! -f "$BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT" ]; then BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/browser-intent.sh"; fi; if [ ! -f "$BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT" ]; then BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT=$(ls -t "$HOME/.grok/installed-plugins/"*/hooks/browser-intent.sh 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); fi; if [ -f "$BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT" ]; then BOPEN_HOOK_RUNTIME=grok bash "$BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT"; fi

BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT="${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pretooluse-bash.sh"; if [ ! -f "$BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT" ]; then BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pretooluse-bash.sh"; fi; if [ ! -f "$BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT" ]; then BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT=$(ls -t "$HOME/.grok/installed-plugins/"*/hooks/pretooluse-bash.sh 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); fi; if [ -f "$BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT" ]; then BOPEN_HOOK_RUNTIME=grok bash "$BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT"; fi

BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT="${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/damage-control.sh"; if [ ! -f "$BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT" ]; then BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/damage-control.sh"; fi; if [ ! -f "$BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT" ]; then BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT=$(ls -t "$HOME/.grok/installed-plugins/"*/hooks/damage-control.sh 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); fi; if [ -f "$BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT" ]; then BOPEN_HOOK_RUNTIME=grok bash "$BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT"; fi

BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT="${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/roster-guard.sh"; if [ ! -f "$BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT" ]; then BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/roster-guard.sh"; fi; if [ ! -f "$BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT" ]; then BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT=$(ls -t "$HOME/.grok/installed-plugins/"*/hooks/roster-guard.sh 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); fi; if [ -f "$BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT" ]; then BOPEN_HOOK_RUNTIME=grok bash "$BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT"; fi

BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT="${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/hammertime.py"; if [ ! -f "$BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT" ]; then BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/hammertime.py"; fi; if [ ! -f "$BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT" ]; then BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT=$(ls -t "$HOME/.grok/installed-plugins/"*/hooks/hammertime.py 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); fi; if [ -f "$BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT" ]; then BOPEN_HOOK_RUNTIME=grok python3 "$BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT"; fi
